The path counts (20 and 21) and both dependency digests are those of the pair this entry replaced.

Only the manifest's fileFacts differ: a valueless JSX attribute on a variant prop is now recorded as the variant key "true" and a boolean literal as its string, so boolean variant keys are usage-tracked. CSS, components and transforms are identical.

Beside the fileFacts difference above, only diagnostics differ: the 28 tags of packages with no dependency path to Animus (react-router-dom, lucide-react, @ark-ui/react, react, @mdx-js/react, prism-react-renderer) no longer leave usage identity uncertain, so they have no identity-uncertain-tag info lines and the identity-uncertain warning counts only the 36 tags in 17 files that still turn whole-component removal off. CSS and components are identical.

Beside the fileFacts and diagnostics differences above, only two statics of src/pages/Examples.tsx differ: AS_CHILD_CODE and TOOLTIP_CODE are templates without substitutions, now evaluated to their cooked text, so an escaped \` reads as `. CSS, components and diagnostics are identical.

Beside the differences above, the manifest gains runtime_tables, each dynamic prop records the names of the shared tables it reads (53 props), and Logo, the one component with a custom dynamic prop, references animusTables.keywords["fontSize"] and its inline scale by key instead of inlining them. CSS, components and diagnostics are identical.

Beside the differences above, emitted configs carry one [prefix, scope] pair instead of slot variable and class names the runtime can derive, compound class names the runtime derives are omitted, each systemPropNames list ships once as a named export of the system-props module, supersededBy references one system table, and transforms are bound per entry instead of by a per-module loop. Class names and CSS are unchanged. The manifest also gains builderFiles, the three system and theme modules whose builder chains the transform marks /* @__PURE__ */ (../test-ds/src/system.ts, ../test-ds/src/theme.ts, src/ds.ts); without it the manifest is byte-identical to the one this entry's previous candidate described. Beside those, each emitted component, class-resolver and composed-family factory call in the replacements begins with /* @__PURE__ */, except an asComponent call whose target is a member path. CSS and diagnostics are identical. Then 94 CSS bytes fewer (264,246 against 264,340): a state's attribute alternatives emit as one :is() group (`.c:is(:disabled, [disabled], …)`). Against 0.1.69's candidate on the same machine, components (204) and diagnostics (73) are identical; only the CSS, and so the manifest digest, moved.

As the earlier accepted vite-app entry, plus 235 bytes: the runtime resolver reads a call site's firstThatWorks value as its preferred member (firstThatWorks always returns its members, so artifact names and the vocabulary record see every one). Then less 295 bytes: code compiled for the official runtime no longer lists each variant's options, which no runtime path reads (251,740 against 252,035 jsBytes). The CSS is identical (cssDigest unchanged); the one identity-uncertain-tag line fewer is the earlier entry's. Plus one animus.discovery.exclude-unmatched warning: the bench's copy of the app leaves out prefixed-variant/, so the config's 'prefixed-variant' pattern matches nothing there. The host used to print that as an uncoded line, which the receipt did not count; it is now a coded finding, which it does: at info severity since animus.discovery.exclude-unmatched's default dropped from warn, with the remedy that names generated files. jsBytes and the CSS are unchanged. Against the candidate this entry replaced (cc091d0b…), every value is the same, the exclude-unmatched count of 1 included; the digest moved only because the receipt's diagnostics key order did: the line now prints at info on stdout, which the receipt reads before stderr. Then plus 324 bytes (252,064 against 251,740 jsBytes): the runtime resolver walks the system props a site sets, in list order, through a position index resolveConfig builds, rather than every name a component lists; class strings and dynamic styles are unchanged. The CSS and the diagnostic counts are as in the candidate this entry replaced. Then less 12 bytes (252,052 jsBytes): the walk lists the listed props a site holds without reading their values, and the loop reads each once, so an enumerable getter is read once, as before the walk. Then less 330 CSS bytes (42,962 against 43,292, so the cssDigest moves): with systemPreference, the theme folds its initial mode's prefers-color-scheme block into that mode's attribute rule, as `[data-color-mode="dark"],:root:not([data-color-mode])`; every computed value is the same. jsBytes and the diagnostic counts are those of the candidate this entry replaced.
